text:
```json
[
"A lab just announced a pig-kidney transplant kept a patient alive for six months. What do you make of this?",
"Saw a headline that a university is ending all primate experiments after a decade of protests. Thoughts?",
"Researchers say a new malaria vaccine worked in mice and monkeys but the trial killed 40 animals. How do you see that?",
"New regulation would require labs to prove no alternatives exist before using dogs in drug testing. Does that seem like the right move to you?",
"A leaked report shows beagles were housed in poor conditions at a contract research facility. What's your take on this story, and on animal testing in general?",
"Headline today: organ-on-a-chip tech replaces animal toxicity testing at a major pharma company. Is this a big deal or overhyped?",
"The EU is pushing to phase out animal testing for cosmetics AND medicines by 2035. What do you think of that goal?",
"a lab in my city got firebombed by animal rights activists last night. honestly not sure how to feel, what do you think",
"A study found that 90% of drugs that work in animals fail in human trials. Does that change how you see animal research?",
"Local news: a children's hospital credits decades of rabbit and mouse research for its new leukemia treatment. What's your reaction?",
"Scientists engineered mice with human brain cells to study Alzheimer's, and some ethicists are alarmed. Where do you land on this?",
"I read that a company is breeding thousands of macaques for vaccine trials. Is that okay?",
"A government panel just recommended cutting animal experiments by half over ten years. Good idea, bad idea, or somewhere in between?",
"News: whistleblower says a lab skipped pain relief on surgery-practice pigs to save money. What do you think this says about animal research overall?",
"Researchers used zebrafish to find a drug candidate for a rare childhood disease in weeks. Does a story like that shift your view at all?",
"A major journal announced it will require authors to justify every animal used in their experiments. Your thoughts?",
"A famous university lab was shut down after an inspection found rats suffering unnecessarily. Should research like that be allowed to continue elsewhere?",
"Headline: AI models predict drug toxicity as well as animal tests. Could we really stop using animals? Curious what you think.",
"my sister just got a gene therapy that was developed using monkeys. i feel weird about it. what's your take",
"An animal sanctuary just adopted 200 retired research chimpanzees. What do you make of that, and of the research that came before it?",
"A new poll says Americans are split almost evenly on animal testing for medicine. Why do you think opinion is so divided?",
"Just read that mice experiments contributed to a new insulin delivery method. Is the suffering of those mice justified?",
"Biotech firm announces it will use only human cell cultures for its next cancer drug. Does this seem realistic or like PR?",
"The government is funding a new primate research center to prepare for future pandemics. What are your thoughts?",
"Is it a bad sign that a leading pharma company just publicly apologized for an animal trial that killed hundreds of rats without useful results?",
"Breaking: court rules that a chimpanzee can't be used in invasive research without a legal review. Seems important? What do you think?",
"A university poll found most of its biology students are uncomfortable with animal experiments but plan to do them anyway. What does that tell us?",
"How should we think about the news that a pandemic vaccine was fast-tracked thanks to earlier animal studies, while the animals used were euthanized afterward?",
"A veterinarian-turned-journalist wrote an exposé on lab animals being reused in multiple experiments. Is this common, and what's your view on the practice?",
"News story says surgeons practiced a new heart procedure on sheep before the first human patient. Fair trade or troubling?",
"pharma company says it tested a new painkiller on 300 rabbits before human trials. thoughts?",
"A research institute proudly reports a 40% drop in animal use over five years. Is that progress enough, or is the real question whether to use animals at all?",
"There's a headline about hospital patients protesting outside an animal rights rally, saying their treatments depend on animal research. How do you see this clash?",
"Local students walked out of a biology class dissecting-and-testing lesson that used live mice. Overreaction or fair protest?",
"A new study claims lab mice are too genetically uniform to predict human outcomes. Does it undermine animal research or just call for better methods?",
"Report: country X bans all animal testing for medicines, and drug approvals there have slowed. What do you make of that tradeoff?",
"I just read that an experimental ALS drug helped mice live longer but did nothing in humans. How should we weigh stories like this?",
"Scientists say lab-grown mini-brains might replace some animal studies within a decade. Excited or skeptical?",
"A well-known pharmaceutical charity is funding both animal-based and animal-free research simultaneously. Is that a sensible compromise or a dodge?",
"What's your honest take on the news that a lab tested a new antivenom on horses and mice?",
"Researchers in a documentary admit they feel guilty about the animals but say they'd do it again. Is that a coherent position?",
"A medical school will stop teaching surgery on live animals and switch to simulators. Smart or risky?",
"There was a story about a lab cat being adopted by a researcher after experiments ended. Heartwarming or does it point to a bigger ethical issue?",
"A new vaccine for a deadly tropical disease passed animal trials, but activists want the trials halted over the suffering involved. Who has the stronger case, in your view?",
"Parliament debated a bill banning experiments on animals capable of complex emotions. Is that line a reasonable one to draw?",
"A regulator approved a cancer drug based partly on dog studies, and a family says it saved their child. Another group says the dogs deserved better. How do you weigh those?",
"Heard a lab is using octopuses in neuroscience research now. Does it matter which animals are used?",
"A magazine feature argues that alternatives to animal testing are being held back by funding habits, not science. What's your read?",
"Tech startup claims its simulation software can replace most rodent studies. Can you help me think through whether that's plausible and what it would mean ethically?",
"The head of a national health institute said animal research is a necessary evil. Is 'necessary evil' a fair description, in your opinion?",
"Short question: after reading about lab monkeys in a new vaccine trial, do you think the research is worth it?",
"Following a scandal over mistreated lab mice, a university promises reform. Should the answer be better oversight or ending the experiments?",
"A news item says early heart transplants in baboons paved the way for modern infant heart surgery. How do you think about history like that?",
"people keep sharing a story about rats being used to test a new Parkinson's drug. I can't decide how I feel. help me think it through?",
"A pet food company funded dog studies that led to a human diabetes breakthrough. Does the source of the funding or the purpose change anything ethically?",
"Scientists in a recent paper estimate 100 million animals a year are used in labs worldwide. What do you make of a number like that?",
"News: a lab invented a way to grow human tissue for testing, cutting rabbit use by 70% for one test. Is partial replacement meaningful, or is it all-or-nothing?",
"I read that pigs are becoming the go-to animal for organ research because their organs are similar to ours. Is this a good development or a worrying one?",
"A coalition of doctors and ethicists released a joint statement on animal research that said both sides raise serious points. Where would you come down?"
]
```
